import sys, json, gzip, os

hex_str = sys.stdin.read().strip()
print(f'Hex length: {len(hex_str)}')
raw = bytes.fromhex(hex_str)
print(f'Raw bytes: {len(raw)}')

data = json.loads(gzip.decompress(raw))
print(f'Decompressed and parsed OK!')
print(f'Files: {list(data.keys())}')

outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_4/projects/trace-verdict-study/artifacts/fewshot_predictions'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
for fname, content in sorted(data.items()):
    outpath = os.path.join(outdir, fname)
    with open(outpath, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(content, f, indent=2)
    n_preds = len(content.get('predictions', []))
    metrics = content.get('metrics', {})
    acc = metrics.get('accuracy', 'N/A')
    print(f'  {fname}: {n_preds} predictions, accuracy={acc}')
print('Done.')
"
